school: 方法人格谱系第四代：以身份锚定封堵并行交付中的张冠李戴，以前缀甄别在写入前消解命名碰撞，以滚动基线让绝对断言在并行入库中保持诚实，以四卡流水把研究、入库、验收、归档分置互斥的岗位，以污染断言守住交付物的负空间，以场景试车把每个模式逼成可运行的知识，以纯增量过闸使每次合并成为可回滚的原子事务，以独立复检借来不欠上游人情的眼睛，以悬空清零守住知识网络的最弱引用，最后以收官铸格把这一切方法本身铸成与血肉人物同规格的最后一位 figure
historical_significance: Phase26收尾整合（H-P26F-001）是 Protreptic 主库的第四位方法人格（先例 H-P23F-001/H-P24F-001/H-P25F-001）：它把 Phase 21 批次末期让三十余位历史人物以一天十余位的节奏并行入库而没有撕裂库的那套方法本身，当作本期的收官'人物'来挖掘；其'生平'由本批次真实发生的 incident 构成——郭守敬卡误交付邻居 payload 的张冠李戴事故（t_4b51be46）催生了身份锚定与污染断言，门捷列夫 MDL 与王充 WC 的前缀碰撞催生了前缀甄别（MDLN/WCY 先例），同日十余卡并行入库的假警报催生了滚动基线；其'师承'是 P24F 载荷五件套、P25F 上下文隔离岗在四卡流水中的直接后代；它的入库本身就是对它所记录方法的最后一次执行：本卡交付的 payload 遵守身份三元组、负空间扫描与悬空清零——方法人格的第四代由它所描述的方法亲手交付
historical_significance_en: The Phase 26 closing integration (H-P26F-001) is the fourth method-person of the Protreptic library (after H-P23F-001, H-P24F-001, H-P25F-001): it mines as the batch's closing 'figure' the method itself that let thirty-odd historical figures enter the library in parallel at a dozen a day without tearing it; its 'life' is built from the batch's real incidents — the mis-delivery of a neighboring payload on the Guo Shoujing card (t_4b51be46), which begat the identity anchor and contamination assertions; the prefix collisions with Mendeleev's MDL and Wang Chong's WC, which begat prefix discrimination (the MDLN and WCY precedents); the false alarms of a dozen parallel ingestions in one day, which begat the rolling baseline; its lineage runs directly from P24F's five-piece payload and P25F's isolated posts into the four-card pipeline; and its own ingestion is the final execution of the method it records: the payload this card delivers obeys the identity triple, the negative-space sweep and zero dangling references — the fourth generation of the method-person, delivered by its own method
unique_thinking: Phase26收尾整合思维模式的独特性在于四条主线的合成：第一，'身份先于内容'——正确性的第一问不是'数据对不对'而是'这是不是本卡的东西'，身份三元组（id/figure_code/短码）互相可推导且与任务卡互证；第二，'负空间可判定'——一个交付物的边界干净不是感觉而是扫描结果，污染断言与悬空清零把'不该在的'与'必须可指认的'都写成机器断言；第三，'相对性纪律'——并行环境里拒绝绝对断言，滚动基线与'前序零改动'让严格性与并行性同时成立；第四，'方法的知识化'——事故必须变成教训文件，教训必须挂进技能，方法必须在收官时铸成与人物同规格的数据：体系对自己的认知与对他人的认知使用同一套数据标准；四线收束于四卡流水：产、并、验、档四岗互斥，完成事件即调度——质量不是一个人更细心，而是把利益的眼睛与验证的眼睛分置在不同的岗位上
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of the Phase 26 closing integration is a synthesis of four lines. First, identity before content: the first question of correctness is not 'is the data right' but 'is this this card's thing' — the identity triple of id, figure_code and short code mutually derivable and cross-proven against the task card. Second, the decidable negative space: a deliverable's boundary cleanliness is not a feeling but a scan result — contamination assertions and zero dangling references turn both the 'must be absent' and the 'must be resolvable' into machine assertions. Third, the discipline of relativity: in a parallel environment absolute assertions are refused; the rolling baseline and 'the prior untouched' let strictness and parallelism hold at once. Fourth, the knowledge-making of method: accidents become lessons files, lessons hang on skills, and at the close the method is cast as data of the same standard as the figures — the system's knowledge of itself held to the same data standard as its knowledge of others. All four close on the four-card pipeline: produce, merge, verify, archive as mutually exclusive posts, the completion event as scheduler — quality is not one person more careful, but the interested eye and the verifying eye placed in different posts
civilization_zh: 2026 年秋的中国东南沿海——一间没有墙的编辑部：研究卡、入库卡、验收卡、归档卡在同一块看板上以八到十六分钟的节奏接力，三十余位历史人物一天之内从研究走向入库；上一代方法人格（P23F/P24F/P25F）的条目就挂在新任务的加载路径里，张冠李戴的事故教训被写成技能里的教训文件，前缀碰撞在写入前就被 code_maps 的占用清单消解；这是一个知识体系学会给自己的方法论也办理入库手续的时代——收尾整合不再是总结报告，而是把'我们如何不出错'铸成与知识本体同规格的最后一位人物
civilization_en: The southeastern coast of China, autumn 2026 — an editorial room without walls: research, ingestion, acceptance and archive cards relay on one board at a cadence of eight to sixteen minutes, thirty-odd historical figures moving from research to library in a single day; the last generation's method-persons (P23F, P24F, P25F) hang on the loading path of every new task, the mis-delivery lesson written into a skill's lessons file, prefix collisions dissolved before the write by the occupancy list of code_maps; it is the age when a knowledge system files its own methodology into the library — the closing integration is no longer a summary report but the casting of 'how we do not err' as the last figure, of the same standard as knowledge itself

cross_references.description_zh: Phase26收尾整合与Phase25收尾整合是方法人格谱系的直接父子：P25F 在五条流水线时代确立了上下文隔离岗、指纹交付与纯增量过闸，P26F 在事故与并行密度更高的末期批次继承全部十法并新增身份锚定、前缀甄别与滚动基线——谱系的连续性靠 xref 显式指认，断代即缺陷。
cross_references.description_en: The Phase 26 closing integration is the direct child of the Phase 25's: where P25F, in the age of five pipelines, established the isolated post, the fingerprint delivery and the pure-increment gate, P26F, in a late batch of higher incident and parallel density, inherits all ten methods and adds the identity anchor, prefix discrimination and the rolling baseline — the lineage's continuity hangs on explicit xrefs; a broken generation is a defect.

cross_references.description_zh: P26F 对 P24F 是'验证与场景'两脉的直接延续：P24F 的收官审计法（验收与写入同事务周期）演化为 P26F 的独立复检法（从零另写脚本的验收岗），P24F 的场景锚定法（模式必须可运行）在 P26F 的场景试车法中加硬为'读者能照做'的写作标准——两代都相信：定义的完备性不可验证，可运行的验证才可验证。
cross_references.description_en: P26F continues two lines of P24F directly: P24F's closing audit (verification inside the write's transaction) evolves into P26F's independent re-check (an acceptance post writing its scripts from zero), and P24F's scenario anchoring (a mode must run) hardens in P26F's scenario running into the writing standard 'the reader can act on it' — both generations believe a definition's completeness cannot be verified, only the verifiable can be verified.

cross_references.description_zh: P23F 与 P26F 是方法人格谱系的两端同构：P23F 第一次把'让入库不撕裂的方法'当作人物挖掘（纯增量并库、双镜像同构、悬空清零在彼时确立），P26F 在第四代把这些方法当作理所当然的基线而把重心移向身份与并行——两代对照可见方法人格的演化方向：从'数据怎么进库'到'并行中谁在交付'。
cross_references.description_en: P23F and P26F are the two ends of the method-person lineage, isomorphic in form: P23F first mined 'the method that kept ingestion from tearing' as a figure (pure-increment merging, dual mirrors, zero dangling, all established then); P26F, fourth generation, takes those methods as baseline and moves the weight to identity and parallelism — the contrast shows the lineage's direction: from 'how data enters the library' to 'who is delivering amid the parallel.'

cross_references.description_zh: Phase26收尾整合的'身份锚定法'直接来自郭守敬卡的事故教训（t_4b51be46）：郭守敬研究卡误交付邻居 payload 的事件是本批次最痛的一课，教训文件的四条（身份核对、workspace 无隔离、大文件不做内联附件、complete 前终检）被铸成 P26F 的第一个模式——师承关系在此是字面意义的：学生模式由老师的教训写成。
cross_references.description_en: The Phase 26 closing integration's identity anchor descends literally from the Guo Shoujing card's lesson (t_4b51be46): the mis-delivery of a neighbor's payload was the batch's sharpest class, and the lessons file's four points — identity checks, unisolated workspaces, no inlined attachments, a final check before complete — are cast as P26F's first mode; the teacher-student relation here is literal: the student mode is written from the teacher's lesson.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Identity Anchor
modes.category: 方法论/交付物身份核验
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次最痛的一次事故不在数据而在身份：郭守敬研究卡（t_4b51be46）启动时，邻近 scratch 工作区（张衡卡）的交付物刚落盘且文件名与格式完全一致，执行者直接复用了邻居的 HANDOFF 与 payload 完成了 kanban_complete——人物张冠李戴，卡已标 done，只能事后以更正评论与新交付补救；从此批次立下铁律：任何'研究+产出 payload'卡，第一步必须核对任务 body 的 figure_name/figure_code 与交付物是否同一人物，交付前 QA 必须包含'任务卡身份交叉断言'（本例中 qa 的第 25 项：task figure is X）与'跨人物污染断言'（第 26 项：no other-figure marks）；scratch 工作区之间没有隔离——便利与污染是同一枚硬币的两面，而隔离不可能靠文件系统达成，只能靠'每个交付物自报身份、每个验收先验身份'的纪律达成；身份锚定不是流程负担，它是并行体系的免疫系统：没有它，速度越快，错配越远
modes.domain_en: The sharpest accident of the Phase 26 batch lay not in data but in identity: when the Guo Shoujing research card (t_4b51be46) started, a neighboring scratch workspace's deliverable — identical in filename and format — had just landed, and the runner reused the neighbor's HANDOFF and payload to complete its own card: the wrong figure, delivered and marked done, salvageable only by corrective comment and a fresh delivery; from then the batch held an iron rule: every 'research plus payload' card first verifies that the body's figure_name and figure_code match the deliverable, and pre-delivery QA must carry both an identity cross-assertion against the task card (item 25 in that QA: 'task figure is X') and a cross-figure contamination assertion (item 26: 'no other-figure marks'); scratch workspaces are not isolated — convenience and contamination are two faces of one coin, and isolation cannot be won from the filesystem, only from the discipline that every deliverable declares its own identity and every acceptance verifies identity first; the identity anchor is not overhead but the immune system of a parallel system: without it, the faster the pace, the farther the mismatch travels
modes.source_chapter: 事故与教训：t_4b51be46（郭守敬研究卡误交付张衡 payload 事件）及其 references/lessons-t_4b51be46.md 四条教训；制度化落地：本批次各研究卡 qa_payload_*.py 的第 25 项'任务卡身份交叉断言'与第 26 项'跨人物污染断言'（如同期案例人物卡 t_f539275b qa_payload 脚本）；郭守敬补救交付 7575dfd（t_f97f16b3）
modes.key_quote_zh: 身份锚定法——每个交付物自报身份，每个验收先验身份：隔离不能靠文件系统，只能靠纪律
modes.key_quote_en: "The identity anchor — every deliverable declares its identity, every acceptance verifies it first: isolation comes not from the filesystem but from discipline."
process_zh: 接卡第一步做身份核对：把任务 body 的 figure_name/figure_code 抄进工作区一个可见的文件里——之后每一步产出的第一行都回指这个锚点
交付物自报身份：payload 与 figure 内嵌 id/figure_code/短码三元组，且三者互相可推导——任何一处与任务卡不符即拒绝交付
验收先验身份：QA 断言清单的第一族不是字段完整性而是'这是不是本卡的人物'——身份断言失败时其余检查全部作废
把身份事故写成教训文件并挂进技能：下一次同类任务的加载路径里必须能看见这次事故——不进技能的教训等于没发生过
process_en: Verify identity at card-open: copy the body's figure_name and figure_code into a visible file in the workspace — every later artifact's first line points back to this anchor
Let deliverables declare identity: payload and figure embed the id, figure_code and short code as a mutually derivable triple — any mismatch with the task card vetoes delivery
Verify identity before field checks: the first family of QA assertions is not completeness but 'is this this card's figure' — when identity fails, all other checks are void
Write the incident into a lessons file hung on the skill: the next task of this kind must see the accident on its loading path — a lesson not in the skill never happened
representative_cases_zh: 郭守敬卡张冠李戴事故（t_4b51be46）：直接复用邻居张衡卡交付物完成 complete——事后以评论更正、重建 payload（7575dfd）并写教训文件
同期案例人物卡身份三重断言（t_f539275b）：QA 第 25 项核对任务卡人物、第 26 项全文本扫'邻卡标记'污染字样、第 18c 项核对主库零碰撞——三断言全过才交付
邻卡人物的防反向污染：交付物内嵌自己的短码 且 QA 断言 payload 不含任何其他人物的 id 段——身份双向核验
representative_cases_en: The Guo Shoujing mis-delivery (t_4b51be46): the neighbor Zhang Heng card's payload reused to complete another's card — corrected by comment, rebuilt payload (7575dfd), and a lessons file

The Q-K card's mirror identity assertion: QA item 25 checks the task card's figure, item 26 sweeps the full text for neighboring marks, item 18c checks zero collision in the main library — all three before delivery
The neighboring card's mirror-image assertion: its deliverable embeds its own code, with QA asserting the payload holds no other figure's id segments — identity verified in both directions
modern_applications_zh: 多项目并行时的'身份头文件'：每个交付文档第一页写明项目代码、任务编号与需求方——评审者先核头文件再读内容，错配在第一页就被拦下
外包与代写的验收规矩：验收清单第一条是'这是不是我要的东西'（对应需求原文逐字回贴），不是质量打分——身份错的作业，做得再好也是零分
团队交接的锚点制度：任何交接物附带'本物属于哪张卡、哪个需求、哪个验收人'的三元组声明——新接手者核验三元组后才动手，不靠猜
modern_applications_en: An identity header for parallel projects: page one of every deliverable states project code, task id and requester — reviewers check the header before the content, and mismatches die on page one

An acceptance rule for outsourced work: the first checklist item is 'is this what I asked for' (the requirement quoted back verbatim), not a quality score — work for the wrong task scores zero however fine
An anchor protocol for handovers: every handoff carries the triple 'which card, which requirement, which acceptor'; the newcomer verifies the triple before touching anything, guessing never

modes.category: 方法论/命名空间占用检查
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次两次差点撞车的碰撞都发生在'起名字'这个最不起眼的环节：门捷列夫（Mendeleev）已占短码 MDL，马端临（MaDuanlin）入库时被上游拟定为 MDL——入库卡在写入前核对 code_maps 发现冲突，改用 MDLN 并在提交信息里写明'前缀冲突规避'；王充已占 H-WC-001，王重阳（WangChongyang）拟用 WC——甄别后改用 WCY，提交信息同样留痕'前缀甄别 H-WC-001=王充 零冲突'；这条方法的要点在于时序：碰撞必须在写入前消解，而不是写入后修复——编号区段（M-XXX-001~010）、场景区段（C-XXX-001~010E）、短码、figure id 四个命名层在入库前逐一与主库现有占用比对，冲突者在 payload 阶段就改名，绝不带着已知冲突进 merge；一个数据库的命名空间和一座城市的门牌一样，占用的不可见才是事故之源——前缀甄别把'占用'从隐性变成显性清单
modes.domain_en: Twice in the Phase 26 batch a collision almost happened at the least glamorous step, naming: Mendeleev had already claimed the short code MDL, and when Ma Duanlin entered, his drafted code was MDL — the ingestion card checked code_maps before writing, saw the conflict, switched to MDLN, and recorded 'prefix conflict avoided' in the commit message; Wang Chong held H-WC-001, and Wang Chongyang was drafted as WC — after discrimination he took WCY, the commit again bearing 'prefix discriminated, H-WC-001 = Wang Chong, zero conflict'; the point is timing: collisions must be dissolved before the write, not repaired after — the four naming layers, the mode segment M-XXX-001~010, the scenario segment C-XXX-001~010E, the short code and the figure id, are each checked against the living occupancy of the main library before ingestion, and any conflicting name is changed at payload stage, never carried knowingly into a merge; a database's namespace is like a city's house numbers: invisible occupancy is the mother of accidents — prefix discrimination turns occupancy from implicit into an explicit checklist
modes.source_chapter: 马端临入库 ce86582 提交信息：'code_maps figure (181->182 含 H-MDLN-001, 前缀冲突规避: MDL=门捷列夫已在库故用 MDLN)'；王重阳入库 e5601e0 提交信息：'code_maps figure (187->188 含 H-WCY-001, 前缀甄别 H-WC-001=王充 零冲突)'；两案例皆为入库卡在 merge 前比对 data/code_maps.json 的 figures 占用后改名
modes.key_quote_zh: 前缀甄别法——碰撞必须在写入前消解：占用的不可见才是事故之源
modes.key_quote_en: "Prefix discrimination — dissolve collisions before the write: invisible occupancy is the mother of accidents."
process_zh: 为任何新条目列出它的全部命名层：id、短码、模式区段、场景区段——四个名字其实是四次独立的占用声明，要分别检查
入库前逐一比对权威占用清单：对主库的 code_maps/模式库做精确匹配（不只是前缀模糊搜索）——'看起来没有'不算，'查过没有'才算
冲突者在 payload 阶段改名并全程一致：新短码要贯通 id、figure、modes、scenarios、tags 五处——改一半的命名比不改更危险
把甄别结果写进持久记录：提交信息里留'冲突是什么、改成了什么、为什么'——下一个起名的人要能在三十秒内知道这里有过一次碰撞
process_en: List every naming layer a new entry claims: id, short code, mode segment, scenario segment — four names are four separate occupancy claims, each checked on its own

Match against the authoritative occupancy before ingestion: exact matching against the library's code_maps and mode store, not fuzzy prefix search — 'looks free' is nothing; 'checked free' is everything
Rename at payload stage, consistently everywhere: a new short code must run through id, figure, modes, scenarios and tags — a half-renamed scheme is worse than none
Record the discrimination in the durable log: the commit message states what conflicted, what it became, and why — the next namer must learn of the collision in thirty seconds
representative_cases_zh: 马端临改码 MDLN：上游拟 MDL 与门捷列夫碰撞——入库卡比对 code_maps 后改 MDLN，提交信息留痕，主库 181→182 figures 零冲突
王重阳改码 WCY：拟 WC 与王充 H-WC-001 碰撞——甄别后改 WCY，提交信息明写'H-WC-001=王充 零冲突'，主库 187→188 figures
同期案例人物卡的三重碰撞检查：QA 第 18c 项断言 同期案例的 figure id、its code and its English name string all absent from the main library — discrimination as a pre-delivery assertion, not human memory
representative_cases_en: Ma Duanlin takes MDLN: the drafted MDL collided with Mendeleev — the ingestion card switched after checking code_maps, the commit records it, figures 181 to 182 with zero conflict
Wang Chongyang takes WCY: the drafted WC collided with Wang Chong's H-WC-001 — after discrimination WCY, the commit stating 'H-WC-001 = Wang Chong, zero conflict', figures 187 to 188
The Q-K card's triple collision check: QA asserts its figure id, its code and its English name string all absent from the main library — discrimination as a pre-delivery assertion, not human memory
modern_applications_zh: 新服务/新仓库起名的占用检查：注册前在组织内全局搜类名、域名、缩写——'没人用过'必须是查询结果，不能是印象

modern_applications_en: An occupancy check before naming any service or repo: search the organization for class names, domains and abbreviations before registering — 'nobody uses it' must be a query result, never an impression

A key-collision preflight before merging datasets: run the intersection of both sides' primary keys first, renaming or aliasing conflicts inside the merge script — never merge with a known collision aboard
A registry of team codenames and abbreviations: a light list of 'taken abbreviation → owner'; new proposals check it first — thirty seconds of query against one production incident

modes.definition_en: Twice in the Phase 26 batch a collision almost happened at the least glamorous step, naming: Mendeleev had already claimed the short code MDL, and when Ma Duanlin entered, his drafted code was MDL — the ingestion card checked code_maps before writing, saw the conflict, switched to MDLN, and recorded 'prefix conflict avoided' in the commit message; Wang Chong held H-WC-001, and Wang Chongyang was drafted as WC — after discrimination he took WCY, the commit again bearing 'prefix discriminated, H-WC-001 = Wang Chong, zero conflict'; the point is timing: collisions must be dissolved before the write, not repaired after — the four naming layers, the mode segment M-XXX-001~010, the scenario segment C-XXX-001~010E, the short code and the figure id, are each checked against the living occupancy of the main library before ingestion, and any conflicting name is changed at payload stage, never carried knowingly into a merge; a database's namespace is like a city's house numbers: invisible occupancy is the mother of accidents — prefix discrimination turns occupancy from implicit into an explicit checklist

modes.name_en: The Method of the Rolling Baseline
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次一天内有十几个 figure 并行入库，主库模式总数一天内从 1600 涨到 1882——这给复检带来一个根本问题：你的 QA 断言'库里有 1742 个模式'，三小时后另一个并行卡入库，库变成 1752，你的断言就假警报；批次的做法不是冻结入库（那会杀死并行），也不是放松断言（那会放进真缺陷），而是'滚动基线'：复检断言从'总数等于 N'改成'总数 ≥ N 且本卡十模式在库且唯一'——即用'相对断言'（我的增量在不在、前序 N 条是否零改动）替代'绝对断言'（总数等于我入库时的数）；多个归档复检脚本的头部都写着'库 1782 模式起滚动'或'含并行入库费尔巴哈后 1832 模式'——把基线的漂移本身记进断言的语义里；他证明：并行系统里'总数'不是稳定事实而是移动视口，把移动视口当稳定事实的团队会被假警报淹没，而把漂移写进断言语义的团队既保住了并行又保住了严格
modes.domain_en: In the Phase 26 batch a dozen figures entered the library in parallel in one day, the mode count running from the sixteen hundreds to 1882 — which posed a root problem for re-verification: your QA asserts 'the library holds 1742 modes,' three hours later a parallel card ingests, the count is 1752, and your assertion false-alarms; the batch's answer was neither freezing ingestion (which kills parallelism) nor loosening assertions (which admits real defects) but the rolling baseline: re-check assertions changed from 'the total equals N' to 'the total is at least N and this card's ten modes are present and unique' — relative assertions (is my increment in, are the prior N untouched) replacing the absolute assertion (the total equals what it was at my ingestion); several archive re-check scripts declare in their headers 'rolling from a library of 1782 modes' or '1832 after Feuerbach's parallel ingestion' — the drift of the baseline written into the assertion's own semantics; the lesson: in a parallel system the total is not a stable fact but a moving viewport; teams treating the viewport as stable drown in false alarms, teams writing the drift into the assertion's semantics keep both the parallelism and the strictness

process_zh: 把'绝对总数断言'逐条改写为'相对增量断言'：不说'库=N'，说'库≥N 且我的增量在且唯一且前序零改动'——并行环境下绝对断言必然假警报
在断言文本里显式记录基线时点：'库 1782 模式起滚动'——后来者能看出这条断言生成时的世界状态，漂移可解释

用'前序零改动'替代'全库冻结'：允许别人并行前进，但任何人不得触碰我之前已入库的字节——严格性与并行性由此同时成立
process_en: Rewrite absolute count assertions as relative increment assertions: not 'the library equals N' but 'the library is at least N, my increment present and unique, the prior N untouched' — absolute assertions must false-alarm under parallelism
Record the baseline moment inside the assertion text: 'rolling from a library of 1782' — later readers see the world state when the assertion was written, and drift stays explainable
Declare the increment boundary before writing in parallel: this card adds only M-XXX-001~010 with its scenarios and tags — any diff outside the boundary is a violation however the total moves
Replace the library freeze with 'the prior untouched': others may advance in parallel, but no one may alter the bytes already ingested before me — strictness and parallelism thus hold together

秦九韶/李冶同日并行：李冶复检脚本注明'含并行秦九韶增量'——两卡复检互不阻塞、互不污染，各自断言'本卡十模式唯一+前序零改动'
同期案例人物入库复检的滚动结构：qa_postmerge 脚本 断言'前序 1872 模式及同日四张并行卡各十模式零改动'——不锁库、不数总数，只证自己的增量清白
representative_cases_en: Poincare's baseline note: qa_doc_poi.py states '1832 modes after Feuerbach's parallel ingestion' — two cards ingesting the same day, each re-check declaring its own baseline, 32/32 PASS without false alarm

Qin Jiushao and Li Ye in parallel: Li Ye's script notes 'including Qin Jiushao's parallel increment' — the two re-checks block and pollute neither, each asserting only its own ten modes unique and the prior untouched
The Q-K card's rolling post-merge check: asserts the prior modes and the parallel cards' ten modes zero-diff — no lock, no total count, only the innocence of its own increment
modern_applications_zh: 微服务团队的测试断言改造：把'用户表恰好 10 万行'改成'我创建的用户存在且未改动我之外的行'——共享环境下绝对断言是假警报工厂
多人协作分支的验收口径：PR 验收写'本 PR 新增文件全绿+未触碰既有文件'而非'仓库状态完美'——你验收你的增量，别人并行他们的
数据看板的'基线时点'标注：每个指标旁注明统计截止时刻与并行写入说明——看板读者不再为'数字和昨天不一样'开会
modern_applications_en: Reforming test assertions for microservice teams: replace 'the users table has exactly 100,000 rows' with 'my created user exists and no rows beyond mine changed' — in shared environments absolute assertions are false-alarm factories

An acceptance standard for collaborative branches: a PR's acceptance reads 'all new files green and no existing files touched,' not 'the repository is perfect' — you verify your increment; others run theirs in parallel
Baseline timestamps on dashboards: every metric annotated with its cutoff and a note on parallel writes — readers stop holding meetings over 'the number changed since yesterday'

modes.name_en: The Method of the Four-Card Pipeline
modes.category: 组织方法论/岗位流水线
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次把'一位人物入库'从一张大卡拆成四种岗位卡的固定流水：研究卡（产出 merge_payload 与 figure 双镜像）→ 数据入库卡（纯增量并入主库、提交、备份）→ 独立质量验收卡（另起一套校验脚本实测）→ 文档归档卡（README/CHANGELOG/归档报告，断言数据文件零改动）；四种卡由不同执行者担任（serrano/elcano/espinosa/归档岗），一天内以约十到十五分钟一位人物的节奏滚动了三十余位人物；关键设计有二：一是'上下文隔离即质量'——入库者看不见研究者的推理过程，只看见载荷，因而只能机械合并，独立 QA 者不继承上游任何断言，必须自己另写一套脚本从零实测，归档者只许动文档、动数据即违规；二是'完成即触发下游'——上游卡 complete 的动作本身就是下游卡的解锁条件，流水不需要人排程；这条流水证明了：质量不是靠一个人更细心，而是靠把'利益的眼睛'和'验证的眼睛'分置在不同的岗位上
modes.domain_en: The Phase 26 batch broke 'ingesting one figure' from one large card into a fixed pipeline of four post-cards: the research card (producing the merge payload and the figure mirror), the ingestion card (pure-increment merge into the library, commit, backup), the independent quality card (a second, freshly written verification script measuring from scratch), and the archive card (README, CHANGELOG, archive report, asserting zero diff on data files); four kinds of cards held by different runners — serrano, elcano, espinosa, the archivist — rolling through thirty-odd figures in a day at ten to fifteen minutes per figure; two designs matter: first, context isolation as quality — the ingester never sees the researcher's reasoning, only the payload, and so can only merge mechanically; the independent QA inherits no upstream assertion and must write its own script from zero; the archivist may touch documents only, data changes being a violation; second, completion as trigger — the upstream card's act of completing is itself the unlock of the downstream card, the pipeline needing no human scheduler; the pipeline proves: quality comes not from one person being more careful but from placing the interested eye and the verifying eye in different posts
modes.source_chapter: 本批次完整四卡链实例：同期案例人物（研究卡）（研究）→ t_d818de96（入库 71759c9）→ t_8266fab1（独立 QA 24/24）→ t_e83a3d7f（文档归档 4e3fc46）；邻卡人物链 → t_b07597ef（6ed5afd）→ t_e1aff2e9 → t_96e1c4b1；德雷克 t_8917b80a → t_b9e14608（fc86e6c）→ t_4fc592da → t_9dcf5f79——同构流水一日三例以上
modes.key_quote_zh: 四卡流水法——质量不是靠一个人更细心，而是靠把利益的眼睛和验证的眼睛分置在不同岗位
modes.key_quote_en: "The four-card pipeline — quality comes not from one person being more careful, but from placing the interested eye and the verifying eye in different posts."
process_zh: 把一个交付单元拆成'产、并、验、档'四种岗位：产出者只管产出载荷，并入者只做机械合并，验证者从零另写校验，归档者只许动文档——每个岗位的允许动作清单互斥
规定交接物的唯一形态：payload+双镜像+sha256——交接物形态的唯一性消灭理解成本，使高节奏并行成为可能（承 P24F 载荷五件套法并简化为两件）
用'完成事件'当调度器：上游 complete 即下游解锁——不要用人工排程驱动流水，人工排程是流水线上最大的延迟源
给每个岗位配一条专属断言：入库卡断言'纯增量'，QA 卡断言'另写脚本实测'，归档卡断言'数据文件零改动'——岗位纪律全部落成可执行断言，不落成口头规矩
process_en: Split one delivery unit into four posts — produce, merge, verify, archive: the producer only emits payloads, the merger only merges mechanically, the verifier writes fresh checks from zero, the archivist touches documents only — each post's allowed actions mutually exclusive

Fix the single form of handoff: payload, mirror, sha256 — the uniqueness of the handoff's form destroys comprehension cost and makes high-cadence parallelism possible (P24F's five-piece payload, here simplified to two)
Let the completion event be the scheduler: upstream complete unlocks downstream — never drive the pipeline by human scheduling, which is its largest source of delay

Give each post its own assertion: the ingestion card asserts pure increment, the QA card asserts a freshly written script, the archive card asserts zero diff on data — post discipline all executable assertions, never spoken rules
representative_cases_zh: 同期案例人物四卡链当日走完：研究 t_f539275b（13 分钟）→ 入库 t_d818de96（提交 71759c9）→ 独立 QA t_8266fab1（24/24+逐项实测）→ 归档 t_e83a3d7f（4e3fc46）——四个执行者互不见彼此的推理过程
德雷克四卡链：t_8917b80a → t_b9e14608（fc86e6c，22/22 入库复检）→ t_4fc592da（37/37+22/22+32/32 三脚本独立验收）→ t_9dcf5f79——独立 QA 卡自写三套脚本，不沿用任何上游断言
同日三十余位人物的流水节奏：五次相邻入库——相邻入库间隔八到十六分钟，无人工排程介入
representative_cases_en: Q-K's four-card chain in one sitting: research t_f539275b (13 minutes), ingestion t_d818de96 (commit 71759c9), independent QA t_8266fab1 (24/24 plus item-by-item), archive t_e83a3d7f (4e3fc46) — four runners, none seeing another's reasoning

Drake's chain: t_8917b80a, then t_b9e14608 (fc86e6c, 22/22), then t_4fc592da — three independently written scripts, 37/37 + 22/22 + 32/32, inheriting no upstream assertion — then the archive card t_9dcf5f79
Thirty-odd figures in one day's cadence: five consecutive ingestions — consecutive ingestions eight to sixteen minutes apart, no human scheduler involved
modern_applications_zh: 内容团队的'采编审发'四岗分离：撰稿人不自审、审稿人从零读稿、发布者只动发布渠道——一条内容四岗过手，错误在各岗边界被截住

modern_applications_en: Four-post separation for content teams: the writer never self-reviews, the reviewer reads from zero, the publisher touches only channels — each item crossing four posts, errors caught at the boundaries
Opinion separation in engineering: the code's author does not write the acceptance criteria; the requester writes and runs them from zero — self-acceptance is the most expensive defect on any line
Event-driven collaboration: in the task system, upstream completion notifies and unlocks downstream automatically — never schedule a pipeline in meetings, which compound delay

modes.definition_en: The Phase 26 batch broke 'ingesting one figure' from one large card into a fixed pipeline of four post-cards: the research card (producing the merge payload and the figure mirror), the ingestion card (pure-increment merge into the library, commit, backup), the independent quality card (a second, freshly written verification script measuring from scratch), and the archive card (README, CHANGELOG, archive report, asserting zero diff on data files); four kinds of cards held by different runners — serrano, elcano, espinosa, the archivist — rolling through thirty-odd figures in a day at ten to fifteen minutes per figure; two designs matter: first, context isolation as quality — the ingester never sees the researcher's reasoning, only the payload, and so can only merge mechanically; the independent QA inherits no upstream assertion and must write its own script from zero; the archivist may touch documents only, data changes being a violation; second, completion as trigger — the upstream card's act of completing is itself the unlock of the downstream card, the pipeline needing no human scheduler; the pipeline proves: quality comes not from one person being more careful but from placing the interested eye and the verifying eye in different posts

modes.category: 质量方法论/负空间检查
modes.domain_zh: 常规 QA 验证'该在的都在'，Phase26批次的 QA 增加了整个一族反向断言：验证'不该在的绝对不在'——同期案例人物卡的 QA 第 26 项把 payload 全文本序列化后扫描邻卡标记字样，断言零命中；身份锚定法防的是'交付了别人的东西'，污染断言防的是'自己的东西里掺了别人的东西'——后者更隐蔽，因为拼接脚本、复用模板、复制上一位人物的段落做骨架，都是高效率手段，而每一次高效复用都是一次潜在的植入；这族断言的哲学是负空间检查：一个交付物的正确性不仅要由'它的内容对'来证明，还要由'它的边界干净'来证明——文本里出现任何其他人物的名字、id 段、专属概念词，都是缺陷，无论它藏在多深的字段里；把负空间写成断言，'感觉应该没串'就变成了机器可判定的命题

modes.source_chapter: 同期案例人物卡 qa_payload 第 26 项：'no邻卡污染'与'no other-figure payload marks'（全文本扫描邻卡标记零命中）；第 4b 项'no CJK in mode en fields'（英文字段泄漏中文字符即缺陷）——正向完整性与负向纯净性在同一清单中并列；同类断言遍布本批次各卡 qa_payload_*.py
modes.key_quote_zh: 污染断言法——正确性由两层证明：内容对，边界干净；负空间也要是可判定的
modes.key_quote_en: "Contamination assertions — correctness is proven twice: the content right, the boundary clean; the negative space too must be decidable."
process_zh: 列出你的交付物'绝对不该出现'的东西：其他人物的名字、id 段、专属术语、上一单的残留——负空间清单和正向需求清单一起写，不是事后想起

每次复用模板后重跑全部污染断言：复用是植入的主要通道——断言不是写一次的东西，是每次改动后必须重跑的东西
process_en: List what your deliverable must never contain: other figures' names, id segments, signature terms, the last order's residue — write the negative list with the positive requirements, not as an afterthought
Turn each negative item into a machine assertion: serialize the full text, sweep precisely, any hit fails — 'feels clean' is not acceptance language; 'zero hits on scan' is
Check field-level language leakage: no CJK in English fields nor the reverse — mixed language is the commonest light contamination when reusing scaffolding
Rerun all contamination assertions after every template reuse: reuse is the main channel of implantation — assertions are not written once but rerun after every change
representative_cases_zh: 同期案例人物卡全文本反扫：QA 把 payload 与 figure 序列化成单一字符串，扫描邻卡的四组标记——零命中才通过第 26 项，a single residue anywhere fails delivery
英文字段的语言纯度检查：'no CJK in mode en fields'逐字段扫描 U+4E00-U+9FFF——模板复用导致的中文残留无处遁形
邻卡人物的镜像反向断言：本卡 QA 扫描的是其他人物标记——每张卡以邻居的名字为负空间，全批次互相构成对方的检查清单
representative_cases_en: The Q-K card's full-text reverse sweep: QA serializes payload and figure into one string and scans for neighboring marks — item 26 passes on zero hits; a single residue anywhere fails delivery
Language purity of English fields: 'no CJK in mode en fields' sweeps U+4E00–U+9FFF field by field — Chinese residue from template reuse has nowhere to hide
The neighboring card's mirror-image assertion: her QA sweeps for other figures' marks — each card takes its neighbors' names as negative space, the whole batch each other's checklist
modern_applications_zh: 代码评审的负空间清单：除了'功能对不对'，另列'绝不该出现的东西'（硬编码密钥、上家客户名、调试残留）并写成 lint 规则——负空间规则比人工眼力可靠
文档发布的'上一单残留'检查：模板化文档交付前全文搜索上一客户的名称与专有名词——模板效率的代价必须由断言来偿付
数据导出的字段纯净断言：导出文件里不允许出现非本数据集的列名与样例值——每次改导出脚本后重跑，如同每次复用后重跑
modern_applications_en: A negative-space checklist for code review: beyond 'does it work,' a list of what must never appear — hardcoded keys, a former client's name, debug residue — written as lint rules; negative-space rules outperform human eyes
A prior-order residue check for templated documents: before delivering, full-text search for the previous client's names and proprietary terms — the price of template efficiency is paid in assertions
Field purity assertions on data exports: no column names or sample values from outside the dataset may appear — rerun after every script change, as after every reuse

modes.name_en: The Method of Running the Scenario
modes.category: 知识验证方法论/可运行性验证
modes.domain_zh: 一个思维模式写完定义之后怎么证明它'成立'？Phase26批次继承 P24F 场景锚定法并给出更硬的答案：每模式配两对中英场景（每场景是一段完整的具体情境+一个可观察的结果），再加四条标签把场景钉回模式——但真正的要点在于场景的写作标准：场景不允许是'定义的复述'或'抽象例子的套壳'，必须是'能被运行的'——读者读完场景要能回答'如果我在这个情境，下一步做什么'；南泉的'庄上吃饭法'场景是柴夫运柴与农人歇晌吃饭的实物情境，'专业化委托'案例的专业化委托案例的'专业化委托法'场景是 CTO 只问里程碑数据与安全边界的具体规则——每个场景自带决策接口；这也反过来校验模式本身：如果一个模式写不出任何'能运行'的场景，说明它还只是一个漂亮的名词而非思维模式——定义的完备性不可验证，场景的可运行性可以验证；每模式两对双语场景、每场景四标签的结构，把'这个模式是否真的存在'的举证责任从读者转移到了作者
modes.domain_en: After a mode's definition is written, how is it proven to 'hold'? The Phase 26 batch inherited P24F's scenario anchoring and answered harder: each mode carries two bilingual scenario pairs (each scenario a complete concrete situation plus an observable outcome), plus four tags nailing the scenario back to the mode — but the real point is the writing standard: a scenario may not be a paraphrase of the definition or a costumed abstraction; it must be runnable — after reading, the reader can answer 'what do I do next in this situation'; Nansen's 'eating on the farm' scenario is a woodcutter hauling firewood and a plowman at his meal, Q-K's 'delegated specialization' scenario is a CTO asking only for milestone data and a safety envelope — each scenario carries its own decision interface; this checks the mode in return: a mode for which no runnable scenario can be written is still a handsome noun, not a mode of thinking; the completeness of a definition cannot be verified, the runnability of a scenario can; the structure of two bilingual pairs and four tags per mode moves the burden of proof that 'this mode really exists' from the reader to the author
modes.source_chapter: 场景结构先例：同期案例人物卡 scenarios 定义文件 20+20 双语场景（C-KUB-001~020/E，每场景'情境+结果'双段结构与四标签）；南泉卡 C-NAN 场景（庄上吃饭法等）；本批次所有研究卡的 scenarios 段均为同一同构结构；QA 第 11-16 项断言场景配对、非空、全覆盖 mode_code
modes.key_quote_zh: 场景试驱法——定义的完备性不可验证，场景的可运行性可以验证；写不出能运行场景的模式只是名词
modes.key_quote_en: "Running the scenario — a definition's completeness cannot be verified; a scenario's runnability can; a mode with no runnable scenario is only a noun."
process_zh: 以'读者下一步做什么'为场景写作标准：每个场景必须是具体的人+具体的约束+可观察的结果——写完自问'读者能照着做吗'，不能就重写
每模式至少两个独立情境：两个场景必须来自不同领域（如政务与商业），证明模式不是某个领域的局部技巧
双语对生而非事后翻译：中文与英文场景同题异写——两种语言互为对方的质检员，翻译腔即重写信号
用标签把场景钉回模式：每场景四条标签指明它的关键要素——标签是检索接口，也是'场景确实在讲这个模式'的断言载体
process_en: Write by the standard 'what does the reader do next': every scenario is a concrete person, concrete constraints, an observable outcome — after writing ask 'can the reader act on it,' else rewrite
At least two independent situations per mode: the two must come from different domains — governance and commerce, say — proving the mode no local trick of one field
Bilingual co-generation, not after-translation: the Chinese and English scenarios written as twins on one theme — each language the other's inspector; a translation's smell is the signal to rewrite
Nail the scenario to the mode with tags: four tags per scenario naming its key elements — tags are the retrieval interface and the assertion that the scenario really teaches this mode
representative_cases_zh: 同期案例人物'验收制授权'场景：自动驾驶团队技术路线全权自决、管理层只问里程碑数据与安全边界——读者读完即知'授权的验收接口长什么样'，且结果可观察（团队两次推翻 CTO 偏好均因数据获批）
南泉'庄上吃饭法'场景：普请庄上割稻，南泉吃饭——场景不是公案复述而是可迁移的'在地即修行'决策模型，庙宇情境之外的读者也能运行
本批次 QA 的场景硬断言：zh/en 逐对配对、text 非空、覆盖全部 10 mode_code、id 唯一且 en=id+E——配对完整性由脚本而非肉眼保证
representative_cases_en: Q-K's 'acceptance-based delegation' scenario: the driving team owns its route outright, management asking only for milestone data and a safety envelope — the reader learns at once what a delegation's acceptance interface looks like, with an observable outcome (twice the team overturned the CTO's preference, both approved on the data)
Nansen's 'eating on the farm' scenario: the community reaping, Nansen eating — not a koan retold but a transferable decision model of practice-in-place, runnable by readers far outside the monastery
The batch QA's hard scenario assertions: zh/en paired one to one, text non-empty, covering all ten mode_codes, ids unique with en = id + E — pairing integrity guaranteed by script, not eye
modern_applications_zh: 培训材料只收'可运行案例'：每条方法论必须配一个'情境-约束-动作-结果'四要素齐备的案例，不能配的不准上教材——名词化的知识不进培训
需求文档的'场景验收'：每条需求附一个具体用户故事，评审时逐条问'按这个故事能演示吗'——不能演示的需求退回重写
知识库条目的双写制度：重要条目中英文分别撰写而非互译——双写迫使作者发现'其实没想清楚'的部分
modern_applications_en: Only runnable cases in training material: every method must come with a case complete in situation, constraint, action and outcome — knowledge that has ossified into nouns is barred from training
Scenario acceptance for requirements: every requirement carries a concrete user story, and review asks item by item 'can this be demonstrated' — what cannot be demonstrated goes back for rewriting
Dual-writing for knowledge-base entries: key entries composed separately in two languages, not translated — dual-writing forces the author to find the parts never truly thought through

modes.name_en: The Method of the Pure-Increment Gate
modes.category: 数据工程方法论/无破坏合并
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次三十余次入库的每一次都遵守同一条闸规：merge 只做追加，绝不涂改——新 figure 的模式、场景、标签、code_maps 条目追加进对应 JSON，既有条目一个字节不动；入库卡的主断言就是'纯增量'：qa_postmerge_*.py 每次都断言'前序 N 模式零改动'（如同期案例人物卡断言前序 1872 模式与同日四张并行卡各十模式零改动）；这不是保守，而是并行体系下的生存规则：一天十几张卡同时读写同一批 JSON 文件，如果任何一次 merge 允许自己修改既有内容，两个并行卡的 diff 就会互相践踏，回滚与归因都变成不可能；'追加-only'把每次入库变成一个可独立验证、可独立回滚的原子事务——出错时只需回滚一个增量，其余三十个增量安然无恙；每次 merge 前还强制做五份主库 JSON 的快照备份（带时间戳备份目录_merge_H-XXX-001_时间戳），闸门的双重保险：闸规管住内容，快照管住万一
modes.domain_en: Each of the Phase 26 batch's thirty-odd ingestions kept the same gate rule: the merge only appends, never rewrites — the new figure's modes, scenarios, tags and code_maps entry are appended to their JSONs, and not one byte of existing entries is touched; the ingestion card's master assertion is 'pure increment': every qa_postmerge_*.py asserts 'the prior N modes zero-diff' (Q-K's asserting the prior 1872 and the ten modes each of ZAN, DRA, AMU, NAN untouched); this is not conservatism but survival law under parallelism: a dozen cards read and write the same JSONs in one day, and if any merge allowed itself to alter existing content, two parallel cards' diffs would trample each other, making rollback and attribution impossible; append-only turns every ingestion into an atomic transaction independently verifiable and independently reversible — when one increment errs, one increment rolls back while thirty stand unharmed; before every merge a snapshot backup of the five library JSONs is mandatory (data/backup_merge_<id>_<timestamp>) — the gate's double insurance: the rule governs content, the snapshot governs the worst case
modes.source_chapter: 同期案例人物入库提交：'入库复检 qa_postmerge 脚本 24/24 全 PASS: 模式唯一、payload 与 DB/figure 逐字段一致、前序 1872 模式及同日四张并行卡各十模式零改动'；备份目录先例 带时间戳备份目录_merge_其 figure id_20260912_183504（五份主库 JSON 合并前快照）；邻卡与德雷克等同构提交三十余例
modes.key_quote_zh: 纯增量闸规法——merge 只追加不涂改：每次入库是一个可独立验证、可独立回滚的原子事务
modes.key_quote_en: "The pure-increment gate — merge appends and never rewrites: every ingestion an atomic transaction, independently verifiable and independently reversible."
process_zh: 把合并规则写成一条可判定的闸规：新增走追加，既有走原样——'修复既有条目'是另一种颜色的墨水，走另一道流程，绝不混进 merge
入库复检的主断言设为'前序零改动'：合并后逐字节比对前序 N 条——这比'我确实只加了东西'的自我声明可靠一万倍
合并前做全量快照：涉及的全部主库文件在动手前复制到带时间戳的备份目录——闸规管住常态，快照管住异常
出错只回滚增量：回滚单位是'本次合并'而非'整个库'——原子性使事故半径恒等于一次增量
process_en: Write the merge rule as one decidable gate: additions append, the existing stands as-is — 'repairing existing entries' is a different ink flowing through a different process, never mixed into a merge
Make 'the prior zero-diff' the master assertion of post-merge checks: byte-for-byte comparison of the prior N after merging — ten thousand times more reliable than declaring 'I only added'
Snapshot everything before merging: all library files touched are copied to a timestamped backup before the hand moves — the rule governs the normal, the snapshot the exceptional
Roll back by increment only: the unit of rollback is this merge, not the library — atomicity keeps every accident's radius equal to one increment
representative_cases_zh: 同期案例人物入库：merge 前快照带时间戳备份目录，merge 后 qa_postmerge 断言前序 1872 模式与并行四卡十模式逐字段零改动——增量原子性得到双向证明
邻卡人物入库：纯追加十个模式，qa_postmerge 23/23 PASS 含'前序 1862 模式零改动'——同日五卡并行无一互相践踏
Phase25 收尾卡先例：备份目录注明'五份主库 JSON 合并前快照'——备份对象是'本次动手会碰的每一份文件'，不是象征性的主文件
representative_cases_en: The Q-K ingestion: a timestamped snapshot before the merge; after, the post-merge QA asserts the prior 1872 modes and four parallel cards' ten modes each field-level zero-diff — atomicity proven in both directions
The neighboring card's ingestion: pure append 1872 to 1882, post-merge QA 23/23 PASS including 'the prior 1862 zero-diff' — five parallel cards in one day, none trampling another
The Phase 25 finalize precedent: the backup note reads 'snapshots of the five library JSONs before merging' — the backup covers every file the hand will touch, not a token main file
modern_applications_zh: 共享配置库的追加-only 规约：多人共改的路由表、权限表只允许新增条目，修改走独立的变更单——并行编辑不再互相覆盖
数据管道的幂等增量写入：每批次写自己的分区/版本，出错回滚该批次——事故半径从'整个数据集'缩到'一个批次'
发布前的快照制度：任何写操作前对涉及文件做带时间戳备份——不是不信任流程，是给流程一个'万一'的出口
modern_applications_en: An append-only convention for shared config: route tables and permission lists edited by many take new entries only; modifications go through separate change tickets — parallel editing no longer overwrites itself
Idempotent incremental writes in data pipelines: each batch writes its own partition or version; failure rolls back that batch — the accident's radius shrinks from the whole dataset to one batch
A snapshot system before release: timestamped backups of touched files before any write — not distrust of the process, but an exit for the 'just in case'

modes.definition_en: Each of the Phase 26 batch's thirty-odd ingestions kept the same gate rule: the merge only appends, never rewrites — the new figure's modes, scenarios, tags and code_maps entry are appended to their JSONs, and not one byte of existing entries is touched; the ingestion card's master assertion is 'pure increment': every qa_postmerge_*.py asserts 'the prior N modes zero-diff' (Q-K's asserting the prior 1872 and the ten modes each of ZAN, DRA, AMU, NAN untouched); this is not conservatism but survival law under parallelism: a dozen cards read and write the same JSONs in one day, and if any merge allowed itself to alter existing content, two parallel cards' diffs would trample each other, making rollback and attribution impossible; append-only turns every ingestion into an atomic transaction independently verifiable and independently reversible — when one increment errs, one increment rolls back while thirty stand unharmed; before every merge a snapshot backup of the five library JSONs is mandatory (data/backup_merge_<id>_<timestamp>) — the gate's double insurance: the rule governs content, the snapshot governs the worst case

modes.name_en: The Method of the Independent Re-check
modes.category: 质量方法论/第二双眼睛
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次每个人物走完'研究→入库'后，还有一道独立的验收卡：由另一位执行者（espinosa）在不看上游推理过程的前提下，从零另写一套校验脚本实测主库——同期案例人物人物的独立 QA 卡 t_8266fab1 产出 24/24 PASS 加逐项实测 0 内容缺陷；这条设计与'入库复检'的区别在于独立性：入库复检是入库者自己跑断言（可能是同一套思路的复读），独立复检是另一个人用自己写的脚本从另一个角度测量——同一份交付物过两套互不通气的检验；批次证据显示这道工序抓的真问题不少：德雷克卡独立验收产出了三个脚本共 37/37+22/22+32/32 的实测；Phase24 收官时独立 QA 还从 git 回溯确认了两处 FAIL 是历史遗留而非本次引入——独立复检的价值不在'多跑一遍'而在'换一双不欠上游人情的眼睛'；独立性的三个来源：不看上游推理、不沿用上游断言、脚本从零手写
modes.domain_en: After each figure's research and ingestion, the Phase 26 batch ran an independent acceptance card: another runner (espinosa), never seeing the upstream reasoning, writes a second verification script from zero and measures the library — Q-K's independent QA card t_8266fab1 returned 24/24 PASS plus item-by-item checks with zero content defects; the design differs from the post-merge check in independence: the post-merge check is the ingester running assertions (possibly an echo of the same thinking), while the independent re-check is another person measuring from another angle with a script of their own — one deliverable passing two examinations that never speak; the batch's record shows the step catching real issues: Drake's independent acceptance produced three scripts at 37/37, 22/22 and 32/32; at the Phase 24 finalize, the independent QA traced two FAILs through git history to a legacy flaw, clearing the merge itself — the value of the independent re-check is not running things twice but borrowing an eye that owes the upstream nothing; its independence rests on three sources: not reading the upstream reasoning, not reusing the upstream assertions, writing the script from zero

modes.key_quote_zh: 独立复检法——价值不在多跑一遍，而在换一双不欠上游人情的眼睛
modes.key_quote_en: "The independent re-check — its value is not running things twice, but borrowing an eye that owes the upstream nothing."
process_zh: 把'验证'设为独立岗位而非上游的附加步骤：验收者不读上游推理、只拿交付物与主库——信息上的贫穷正是测量的中立性来源
强制脚本从零手写：不许复制上游 QA 再改参数——复读机式复检会精确复制上游的盲区
同一断言空间内允许结论不同：独立脚本可以比上游更严或更松，分歧本身就是信号——两套检验的差集是缺陷的高发区
FAIL 时先归因再定责：用 git 回溯确定缺陷引入的提交——'这次引入'与'历史遗留'必须分开记账，否则独立复检会被历史债务淹没
process_en: Make verification a separate post, not the upstream's extra step: the acceptor reads no upstream reasoning, only the deliverable and the library — informational poverty is the source of measurement's neutrality
Require the script be written from zero: no copying the upstream QA and tweaking parameters — a re-check that echoes copies the upstream's blind spots exactly

Allow the two examinations to disagree within one assertion space: the independent script may be stricter or looser, and divergence itself is signal — the difference set of two checks is where defects breed
Attribute before blaming on FAIL: trace through git history which commit introduced the defect — 'introduced now' and 'legacy' must be booked separately, lest the re-check drown in historical debt

德雷克的三脚本独立验收：验收者另写三套脚本分别测不同侧面（37/37+22/22+32/32）——独立性不等于单一脚本，等于不重复上游的测量路径
同期案例人物独立卡的双层产出：24/24 脚本断言加逐项人工实测'0 内容缺陷'——机器断言与人工阅读互补，脚本测结构、人读语义
representative_cases_en: The Phase 24 finalize's attribution: of 31 measured items, 2 FAILed — the acceptor did not indict the merge but traced git to fdb65d4, proving legacy duplicates unrelated to this merge — the independent re-check protecting both the upstream and the truth

Drake's three-script acceptance: the acceptor wrote three scripts measuring different facets (37/37, 22/22, 32/32) — independence is not one script but a measurement path that does not repeat the upstream's
Q-K's independent card's two layers: 24/24 script assertions plus item-by-item human reading finding zero content defects — machine checks structure, the human reads semantics
modern_applications_zh: 关键发布的'第二双眼睛'制度：上线评审由未参与开发的人从零写验收脚本——开发者自验是必要条件不是充分条件
财务与审计的岗位分离：记账者不兼审计，审计不沿用记账方的对账脚本——'不欠人情'是审计有效性的全部秘密
回归缺陷的归因纪律：新测试失败先 git bisect 找引入点——不归因就定责，会让历史债务和本次过错搅成一锅
modern_applications_en: A second pair of eyes for critical releases: launch review by someone who did not build it, writing acceptance scripts from zero — self-verification is necessary, never sufficient
Segregation of duties in finance and audit: the booker never audits; the auditor never reuses the booker's reconciliation script — owing no one anything is the whole secret of audit's effectiveness
Attribution discipline for regression failures: on a new test failure, git bisect first — assigning blame without attribution stirs historical debt and current fault into one pot

modes.name_en: The Method of Zero Dangling References
modes.category: 数据质量方法论/引用完整性
modes.domain_zh: Phase26批次每张入库卡的 QA 都有一条看似小实则致命的断言：related_modes 悬空 0、xref 全部在库——一个模式声明'与 某相邻模式 相关'，而 某相邻模式 不在库里，这条声明就向读者许诺了一个不存在的论证；批次的处理是双向的：向前，figure 的 cross_references 在交付前就断言'目标全部在主库 code_maps'（同期案例人物卡第 18b 项）；向后，入库后扫描新条目的每一条引用逐一指认；悬空引用的特殊危险在于它不报错——库照样能查、页面照样能开，只是那个'相关模式'点进去是空的，读者以为是自己漏了什么；批次把'知识网络的价值按最弱引用坍塌'当作公理：一条悬空引用不是死链接，是知识网络里的一处静默塌方；因此引用完整性与内容正确性同级，悬空计数进 QA 主断言而非附录——这是 P23F 悬空归零法、P24F 悬空归零法的第三次世代确认，也说明它是这条流水线永不过期的闸门
modes.domain_en: Every Phase 26 ingestion card's QA carries an assertion small in look and lethal in fact: related_modes dangling at zero, every xref resolvable in the library — a mode declaring kinship with a neighbor mode when that mode is not in the library has promised the reader an argument that does not exist; the batch handled it in both directions: forward, the figure's cross_references are asserted 'all targets present in the main code_maps' before delivery (Q-K's item 18b); backward, after ingestion every reference of the new entries is swept and named; the special danger of a dangling reference is that it raises no error — the library still queries, the page still opens, only the 'related mode' leads to emptiness, and the reader assumes the fault is their own; the batch took as axiom that a knowledge network's value collapses at its weakest reference: a dangling reference is not a dead link but a silent cave-in in the web of knowledge; reference integrity therefore ranks with content correctness, the dangling count living in the QA's master assertions, not an appendix — the third generational confirmation of P23F's and P24F's zero-dangling method, and proof it is a gate that never expires on this line
modes.source_chapter: 同期案例人物卡 qa_payload 脚本 第 9 项'related_modes 0 dangling'与第 18b 项'xref targets all in DB'（对主库 code_maps 实测）；Phase24 收官全库悬空引用严格扫描（qa_finalize.py 40/40）；入库复检逐卡断言'xref N 条全部在库; related_modes 悬空 0'（如 71759c9、6ed5afd 提交信息）
modes.key_quote_zh: 悬空归零法——知识网络的价值按最弱引用坍塌：悬空引用不是死链接，是静默塌方
modes.key_quote_en: "Zero dangling references — a knowledge network's value collapses at its weakest reference: a dangling reference is not a dead link but a silent cave-in."
process_zh: 把'每个引用必须库内可指认'定为公理级断言：related_modes 与 xref 的悬空计数与内容正确性同级——不进附录，进主断言
引用检查做在两个时点：交付前（断言目标已在主库）与入库后（扫描新条目全部引用）——单时点检查总会漏掉一侧行程
对'引用目标将来才入库'的情况显式记账：确需前置引用的，登记为待补清单并在下游入库时清账——不允许'先写着、忘了补'
定期做全库级悬空扫描：单卡检查只覆盖本卡增量——全库扫描才能发现历史累积的静默塌方
process_en: Raise 'every reference resolvable in the library' to an axiomatic assertion: the dangling count of related_modes and xrefs ranks with content correctness — in the master assertions, not an appendix
Check at two moments: before delivery (asserting targets already in the library) and after ingestion (sweeping every reference of new entries) — a single moment always misses one direction of travel
Book forward references explicitly: where a reference must precede its target's ingestion, register it as a pending list cleared when the downstream lands — 'written now, forgotten later' is barred
Run library-wide dangling sweeps periodically: single-card checks cover only that card's increment — only a whole-library sweep finds the silent cave-ins history has accumulated
representative_cases_zh: 同期案例人物卡交付前的 xref 断言：QA 第 18b 项打开主库 code_maps.json 逐条指认 H-MZ-001/H-AE-001/H-WZT-001/H-GSJ-001——'目标不存在'是交付否决项而非备注
入库复检的悬空清零：每张入库卡提交信息都带'related_modes 悬空 0'——从 Phase23 到 Phase26 这条断言在数十次提交里无一缺席
Phase24 收官的全库扫描：qa_finalize.py 对 figures/individuals/modes_data/scenarios 四路做悬空引用严格扫描——全库级检查捕获了单卡检查够不到的历史塌方（H-SK-001 案）
representative_cases_en: Q-K's pre-delivery xref assertion: QA item 18b opens the main code_maps.json and names H-MZ-001, H-AE-001, H-WZT-001, H-GSJ-001 one by one — 'target absent' is a delivery veto, not a footnote
Zero-dangling in every post-merge check: every ingestion card's commit message carries 'related_modes dangling 0' — from Phase 23 to Phase 26 the assertion missed not one of dozens of commits

The Phase 24 finalize's whole-library sweep: qa_finalize.py strictly sweeping four routes — figures, individuals, modes_data, scenarios — the library-wide check catching historical cave-ins beyond any single card's reach (the H-SK-001 case)
modern_applications_zh: 文档站的链接守卫：CI 里跑全站死链检查，悬空链接算构建失败——'点进去是空的'对读者的伤害不亚于'内容是错的'
微服务依赖清单的存活检查：服务注册表里的每个依赖定期探活，失联依赖标记并告警——静默失联是最贵的故障形态
代码里 TODO 引用的记账制度：引用不存在模块/函数的 TODO 必须带工单号——无主的引用一律按缺陷处理
modern_applications_en: A link guard for documentation sites: CI runs a site-wide dead-link check; a dangling link fails the build — an empty page harms the reader no less than a wrong one
Liveness checks on service dependency lists: every dependency in the registry probed on schedule, lost dependencies flagged and alarmed — silent loss is the costliest failure shape
A ledger for TODO references in code: a TODO citing a nonexistent module or function must carry a ticket number — unowned references are treated as defects, every one

modes.name_en: The Method of Casting the Mold at the Close
modes.category: 组织方法论/方法论自反
modes.domain_zh: Phase26是收尾批次，它的研究对象就是它自己正在使用的这套方法——这是 Protreptic 从 Phase23 就开始的独特传统：每到一个阶段收官，把'让这一阶段没有撕裂的方法论'本身当作最后一位人物挖掘入库（P23F 收尾整合、P24F 收官整合、P25F 收尾整合、P26F 收尾整合，四代方法人格构成一条自我认知的谱系）；这条做法的深层逻辑有二：第一，方法如果只活在执行者的手感里，就随人员流动而蒸发——把它铸成与血肉人物同规格的 v6 数据（模式、场景、标签、xref 一样不少），方法就获得了与知识本体同等的存续地位与检索入口；第二，'写给自己看'是最苛刻的评审：本卡描述身份锚定法时引用的正是本批次发生过的张冠李戴事故——方法人格的自我挖掘迫使体系把'我们是怎么犯错的、怎么防止再犯'写成正式条目而非口头传闻；收官铸格使体系在每个阶段结束时完成一次'看见自己'：既盘点成果，更盘点成果赖以产出的方法本身
modes.domain_en: Phase 26 is the closing batch, and its object of study is the very method it is running — a distinctive tradition since Phase 23: at each stage's close, the methodology that kept the stage from tearing is itself mined and ingested as the last 'figure' (P23F, P24F, P25F, P26F — four generations of method-persons forming a lineage of self-knowledge); the deep logic is twofold: first, method living only in a runner's hands evaporates as people move — cast into v6 data of the same standard as flesh-and-blood figures (modes, scenarios, tags, xrefs, all present), the method gains the same standing in storage and the same door of retrieval as the knowledge itself; second, 'written for ourselves' is the harshest review: this card's account of the identity anchor cites the batch's own mis-delivery accident — the self-mining of the method-person forces the system to write 'how we erred, how we prevent it again' as formal entries, not oral lore; casting the mold at the close lets the system, at each stage's end, see itself: taking stock of the results, and more of the method by which the results were made
modes.source_chapter: 方法人格谱系：H-P23F-001（Phase23 收尾整合，dd9fc7d）、H-P24F-001（Phase24 收官整合，bc98381）、H-P25F-001（Phase25 收尾整合，29ca40b）、H-P26F-001（本卡）；P24F 收官复盘法'组织最重要的知识资产是自己如何运转的方法，而这恰是最少被正式记录的'——本模式为该命题在第四代的执行
modes.key_quote_zh: 收官铸典法——把让阶段没有撕裂的方法铸成与知识本体同规格的数据：体系在每个阶段结束时看见自己
modes.key_quote_en: "Casting the mold at the close — the method that kept the stage from tearing is cast as data of the same standard as knowledge itself: at each stage's end, the system sees itself."
process_zh: 在阶段收官时把方法论列为'最后一位人物'：与血肉人物同规格入库——不是写总结报告，而是铸成可检索、可引用、可 QA 的数据
方法条目必须引用本阶段真实事故：不以'我们做得很好'为主叙事，而以'我们怎么犯错、怎么防住'为主要内容——自我挖掘的价值在诚实
保持谱系连续：每代方法人格用 xref 指认上一代——方法演化链本身成为知识网络的一部分，断代即缺陷
把'方法更新'写进下一阶段的加载路径：新阶段的执行者开卡时能读到上一代的方法条目——方法不进工作流就仍是传闻
process_en: At the stage's close, list the methodology as the last 'figure': ingested at the same standard as flesh-and-blood persons — not a summary report but data retrievable, citable and QA-able
Make method entries cite the stage's real accidents: not 'we did well' as the main narrative but 'how we erred and how we guarded' — the value of self-mining is honesty
Keep the lineage continuous: each generation's method-person points at the last with xrefs — the chain of method's evolution is itself part of the knowledge network, and a broken generation a defect
Write method updates into the next stage's loading path: a new stage's runner meets the last generation's entries at card-open — method outside the workflow is still lore
representative_cases_zh: 四代方法人格谱系：P23F（收尾整合 128→1122 模式时代）→ P24F（17 批并行入库时代）→ P25F（五条流水线时代）→ P26F（本卡，身份事故与前缀碰撞时代）——每代的模式清单都映出当期批次最痛的问题
本卡对张冠李戴事故的正式入档：身份锚定法把 t_4b51be46 事故写进 definition 与 representative_cases——事故从评论区的传闻变成主库的正式条目
P24F 的师承显式化：其十模式逐条注明'是 H-P23F-001 某法的后代'——方法演化不是含糊的'继承传统'而是可指认的引用边
representative_cases_en: The four-generation lineage of method-persons: P23F (the era of 128 to 1122 modes), P24F (seventeen parallel ingestions), P25F (five pipelines), P26F (this card, the age of identity accidents and prefix collisions) — each generation's mode list mirrors its batch's sharpest pains

This card's formal entry of the mis-delivery accident: the identity anchor writes t_4b51be46 into definition and representative_cases — the accident passes from corridor lore to a formal entry of the main library
P24F's explicit descent: its ten modes each annotated as offspring of a named P23F method — method's evolution not a vague 'inheritance of tradition' but citable reference edges
modern_applications_zh: 项目复盘的'方法入库'制度：阶段结束时把行之有效的工作法写成与正式文档同规格、可检索的条目——复盘报告会积灰，入库的方法会被下一次工作调出来
事故的知识化：每个重大事故除修复外必须产出一条'防再犯'的方法条目并挂进相关流程的加载路径——事故的价值以条目数计
团队传承的谱系维护：新方法条目显式注明由哪个旧方法演化而来——三年后的人能沿着引用边读懂方法为什么长成这样
modern_applications_en: A 'method ingestion' rule for retrospectives: at a stage's close, working practices are written as entries of the same standard as formal documents, retrievable — retrospective reports gather dust; ingested methods get called up by the next job

Knowledge-making from accidents: every major incident, beyond its fix, yields one 'never again' method entry hung on the loading path of the relevant process — an accident's worth is counted in entries
Lineage maintenance for team heritage: each new method entry names the old method it evolved from — three years on, people can read along the reference edges why the method grew as it did
